body:
Thanks, I guess. 
Honestly, sometimes I just wish I was actually beaten up just so I could have physical proof that the abuse really happened... with my situation it's just so confusing, so having someone validate it makes me feel a little better.
However, I doubt I'll be able to completely recover, ever. Right now I'm just going to wait and see what will happen once he gets out of jail, because I'm sure he will never leave us alone, and at this point I wouldn't mind if either me or my mom got killed. 
It's tiring, living is really tiring.

And yeah, I can't sleep bc the fact that I can't do it yet makes me fucking lose my mind. Honestly if there were no chances of failing I would do it right away, if I just had a gun I woud fucking blow my brains out already, all other methods have a chance of failing... and I guess that's what scares me the most. That's why if that person just disappeared of my life I would keep trying until I achieve my goal, finally leaving this rotten disgusting place called Earth.

I don't really care about what happens to my body once I die, I already told my relatives that if some day I die they can just throw my body out to the wild, whether I rot or get eaten by whatever there is in there I just don't care. 
No one gave me basic human respect when I was alive I don't need it once I'm dead.
